description: Round 6 stage 1 for backbone hfl/chinese-macbert-base (configs/recipes_v1.json round6_backbones): exactly the S3 recipe of train_v2.json (weak build 20261003-weak_v2, setting S3, 749 chapters, 6 epochs, eval every half epoch, patience 3, lr 3e-5) with the backbone swapped; seeds 1-3; the checkpoints are the stage 1 starting points of this backbone. Character-level BIO tagger trained on weak labels: hfl/chinese-roberta-wwm-ext plus one linear layer over 13 labels (O, B-/I- of six types), partial-label loss (a one-label set is ordinary cross-entropy; an all-13 set is left out). The setting (S1/S2/S3) picks the weak build's label file; only its 'train' chapters (1-780 minus the 31 dev chapters) are used, and the weak build's record (runs/<weak_build>/config.json) must match the label file's sha256, the snapshot and the training chapters. Dev (the answered dev chapters in gold_dev) picks the checkpoint inside a run (best strict micro F1, ties: earlier) and, across runs, the setting. Hyperparameters are the common defaults from the backbone survey, fixed before any run, not tuned on dev. AdamW applies weight_decay to weight matrices only (not biases or LayerNorm). quote_map: six characters the HFL vocabulary lacks, replaced one for one before tokenizing so offsets do not move. deterministic: torch deterministic algorithms in strict mode (an op without a deterministic version stops the run), so the same seed repeats exactly. v2 (2026-10-03): weak build 20261003-weak_v2 (adds S1b) and dev answers v2 (31 chapters, 1580 scored spans); hyperparameters unchanged from v1 and never tuned. Selection rule, written before any v2 run: each setting is trained with seeds 1, 2, 3; inside a run the checkpoint is the one with the best dev micro F1 (ties: the earlier step); the setting with the highest mean dev micro F1 over its seeds is the main weak-supervision system (main table, learning curve). Every setting is then run on the test chapters once, after the settings are frozen, for the ablation table; nothing is chosen on the test set.

backbone.download_note: pytorch_model.bin 411,582,858 bytes plus tokenizer files (vocab 21128, the same vocabulary as chinese-roberta-wwm-ext)
